# NATS

`c.NATS` calls the API's NATS group. The NATS server of the fleet.

## Methods

| Method                   | Returns                    | Permission    | Description                         |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------- | ------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| [`Status(ctx)`](#status) | `*Response[ComponentList]` | `health:read` | Show the health of the NATS server. |

### Status

```go
func (s *NATSService) Status(
	ctx context.Context,
) (*Response[ComponentList], error)
```

Show the health of the NATS server.

The NATS server, with each of its sub-components, from the health status of the
controller.

It sends `GET /api/nats/status`, and needs the permission `health:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Show the health of the NATS server, `go run nats.go status`:

```go
resp, err := c.NATS.Status(ctx)
```
